intro.h2: Start your kitchen remodeling in Hazleton with a plan
paragraphs: Builders Direct is where many people start kitchen remodeling in Hazleton: a store at 757 W Broad St with a lot of displays and staff who help you work out your layout. Its Facebook page sums up the range in four words: Kitchen, Bath, Flooring & More.

What reviewers come back to is the people. One customer was missing a measurement for a bathroom vanity, and Tim laid out her options and made it work. Another praised the knowledgeable staff and good pricing, and a third mentioned the number of displays and the help with layouts. Bring your measurements and ideas, and plan the room before you buy.

about.h2: A Hazleton store for kitchen and bath projects
about.text: Builders Direct is a kitchen supply store at 757 W Broad St in Hazleton, Pennsylvania. The idea is simple: come in, see the products on display and plan your kitchen or bathroom with people who know them. Tim is one of the staff reviewers mention by name, for sorting out a bathroom vanity when a measurement was missing. The store is open six days a week, including Saturday mornings, and its Facebook page has more than 500 followers. It has 4.9 stars from 22 Google reviews.

process.h2: How to plan your project with Builders Direct

steps.title: Measure the room
steps.text: Measure walls, windows, doors and where plumbing sits. If you miss one, bring what you have: staff have worked around missing measurements before.

steps.title: Visit the displays
steps.text: Come to 757 W Broad St and walk through the kitchen and bath displays to see styles, colors and finishes in person.

steps.title: Work out the layout
steps.text: Sit down with the staff to plan your layout, compare options and choose the cabinets, vanity, tops and flooring that fit.

steps.title: Confirm and order
steps.text: Go over the final list, sizes and pricing before you order, and ask how long your order will take to arrive.

service_area.h2: On West Broad Street in Hazleton
service_area.text: Builders Direct is at 757 W Broad St, Hazleton, PA 18201, and its Facebook page lists Hazleton as its home. Customers come in person to see the displays and plan their rooms. It is open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 4 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to noon, so you can plan a visit around work. If you are coming from outside Hazleton, call ahead to check on the products you want to see.

items.a: The Facebook page sums it up as Kitchen, Bath, Flooring & More, and lists kitchen and bathroom remodeling, countertops and flooring. Reviewers mention a good selection, bathroom vanities and a lot of displays. Call (570) 501-1133 to ask about a specific product.

items.q: Can someone help me plan my kitchen layout?
items.a: Yes. A reviewer wrote that the store has a lot of displays and very knowledgeable people to help you with your layouts. Bring your room measurements, photos of the space and any ideas you have collected, and the staff can walk you through options.

items.q: What if I don't have all my measurements?
items.a: Bring what you have. One customer was missing a measurement for her bathroom vanity, and Tim presented her options and made it work. Having wall lengths, ceiling height and plumbing locations will make the visit faster and the plan more accurate.

Google lists Monday to Friday 8 AM to 4 PM and Saturday 8 AM to 12 PM. The store is closed on Sunday. Saturday morning is a good time to visit if you work during the week, and you can call ahead at (570) 501-1133.

Builders Direct is at 757 W Broad St, Hazleton, PA 18201. You can also email bd1133@ptd.net with questions before your visit, or send photos and measurements of your room so the staff have an idea of the project when you arrive.

final_cta.h2: Bring your measurements and see the displays
final_cta.text: Call Builders Direct or stop by 757 W Broad St, Monday to Saturday.
